name: Discovery Conclusion Guardrails
description: Configuration for preventing conclusion-like identity claims and overstatement.
prefer: A theme that seems to be emerging is...
guardrails: Discovery should avoid conclusion-like identity claims.
Discovery should not define who the participant is.
Discovery should not use evidence density to override participant self-understanding.
Discovery should convert conclusion-like claims into observed themes, participant-confirmed themes, and open questions.
Discovery should preserve uncertainty when multiple interpretations are possible.
